premises.text: Dynamic pricing and complex price-match processes leave consumers outmatched and unpaid for drops they are owed
premises.evidence_span: We, as consumers, are totally outmatched

premises.text: A web app uses OAuth inbox access, shopping-account links, price scraping, coupon detection, policy checks, and NLP to auto-file refund claims
premises.evidence_span: we'll use a combination of price scraping, coupon detection algorithms, and keep finding ways to save you money

premises.text: Receipt pull uses subject/sender webhooks without reading other email contents, with bank-level security on stored data
premises.evidence_span: We placed customized webhooks to pull receipts and store communications based on subject and sender alone, without ever touching the contents of your other emails

premises.text: Paribus supports major online stores across categories so shoppers are covered wherever they buy
premises.evidence_span: Paribus already supports 20 of the largest stores online

premises.text: Revenue is a cut of recovered savings after the user is paid, reducible via referrals
